column1: # Spanish adjectives, adverbs and function words — authoring source for core-es.
# Adjectives and numerals become word cards, so only those rows carry an id. A
# numeral no sentence uses yet carries `-` instead: every card needs an example,
# so it stays a lexeme until one exists. Never type a Spanish numeral here — the
# build checks each against `src/languages/es/numerals.ts` and refuses a spelling
# that module would not produce. Leave the id off
# a new row: the build assigns one and writes it back.
# Adjectives are listed in the masculine singular; the build derives the other
# surface forms so that "cansada" in a sentence still links to this lexeme.
# Words the sentences already used but the lexicon did not carry. New adjectives
# go below the existing ones: word-card ids are positional within the adjectives.
